Immediate Start!

The team at Flexiforce are seeking an experienced and motivated Daytime Team Leader for a well-established Manufacturing & Distribution Company based in Revesby, NSW.
This is a hands-on leadership role. The successful applicant will play a key role in supervising the essential day-to-day running of the business within the warehouse, incl. Pick/Pack and Forklift Operations, as well as ERP/WMS systems use.
This is an excellent opportunity for someone looking to take the next step in their warehousing career with a respected and growing company.


Work Hours:
•	6:00am – 2:00pm or 8:00am – 4:00pm
•	Location: Revesby NSW

Main Duties Include:
•	Leading and supervising a small warehouse team
•	Overseeing daily pick, pack and dispatch operations
•	Allocating work and monitoring workflow to meet daily deadlines
•	Operating ERP/WMS systems for stock movements, reporting and order processing
•	Conducting quality checks and maintaining high safety standards
•	Operating forklifts, including loading/unloading and stock replenishment
•	Training and supporting new team members
•	Completing daily reporting and liaising with Warehouse Management


Main Criteria:

•	Previous experience in warehouse pick/pack and dispatch operations
•	Demonstrated team leadership or supervisory experience
•	Experience using ERP or Warehouse Management Systems (SAP, Oracle or similar)
•	Current LF Forklift Licence (High Reach experience highly regarded)
•	Strong organisational and time management skills
•	Excellent communication and problem-solving abilities
•	Commitment to workplace safety and quality standards
•	Ability to lead by example in a fast-paced environment

Reliability is a MUST!

If this sounds like you and you would like to apply, please get in touch ASAP.
Email your resume to: enquiries@flexiforce.com.au
